directive_spec.directive_text: Initialize NOVALI for a bounded local research and implementation planning run.
directive_spec.clarified_intent_summary: Create reviewable local artifacts, keep all execution governed, and preserve operator-readable evidence before continuation.
success_criteria: directive validates in the Operator Shell
governed execution creates a reviewable local work artifact
autonomy remains bounded and emergency-stop controlled

milestone_model.completion_signal: the Operator Shell shows the directive as loaded

constraints: do not treat evidence packs as execution authority
do not mutate protected roots without explicit validation
stop_conditions: memory guard requires pause or recycle
